enemies.name: Wield Arms
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. The smoke dissipates and the broken armor sinks into the sand, as the bleached bones hope to return in spring.

abilities.text: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

enemies.name: Wield Arms - Oppress
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. Swords and spears lie buried, and tears of blood have stopped flowing. The bleached bones shall know spring no more.

abilities.text: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

enemies.name: Draw Bow
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Bow. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The wind stirs the sand, the long bow a full moon; listen to the string ring, and hope for its bearer's return.

abilities.text: Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

enemies.name: Draw Bow - Screech
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Bow'. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The sandstorm rages, and the bowstring wails, yet its bearer is nowhere to be seen, but for the lingering echoes of the string's ring.

abilities.text: Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

enemies.name: Uproot Mountain
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Strength'. The histories write: 'Cold wind howls, for the brave never returned.' Their names are forgotten to history, but their legacies remain in a nation secure. So long as their strength holds, the way home shall be found.

abilities.text: Damage from Stamp reduced
When on a Glyph Tile, disables stamp effects for all glyphs on current tile and all connected Glyph Tiles

enemies.name: Uproot Mountain - Overshadow
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Strength'. The histories write: 'Cold wind howls, for the brave never returned.' Their names are forgotten to history, and the nation is not yet secure. Even as their strength holds, they shall never find their way home.

abilities.text: Damage from Stamp reduced
When on a Glyph Tile, disables stamp effects for all glyphs on current tile and all connected Glyph Tiles

enemies.name: Raise Tide
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Brush'. At the end of the history book is a comment in light-colored ink: 'Spring and autumn know me, and I shall fear not the long night.' The writer believes that right and wrong will become apparent by the historian's brush.

abilities.text: Writes the glyph Soldier when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

enemies.name: Raise Tide - Summon
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Brush'. At the end of the history book is a comment in dried ink: 'Spring and autumn are not me. How could they know how long the night is?' If history can be altered, and writing forged, who will seek justice for the innumerable souls lost to the ages?

abilities.text: Writes the glyph Soldier when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

enemies.name: Ribbon in the Waves
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Falsehood'. 'He who claims himself pure should be cast into murky waters.' Purity and corruption, truth and falsehood, are never decided by the fins swimming in the river.

abilities.text: Can move through empty Glyph Tiles
Exits glyph form when stamped by a Stamp, becoming stunned, and cannot turn back to glyph form for a while
Cannot be teleported

enemies.name: Ribbon in the Waves - Rust
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Falsehood'. 'He who claims himself pure should be cast into murky waters.' Purity and corruption, truth and falsehood, are never easy to tell. Who can tell if the words of the swimming fins are true?

abilities.text: Can move through empty Glyph Tiles
Exits glyph form when stamped by a Stamp, becoming stunned, and cannot turn back to glyph form for a while
Cannot be teleported

enemies.name: Thief in the Clouds
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Thief'. At the end of the history book is a comment in light-colored ink: 'The thief stole the ink, and sundered spring and autumn.' The writer understands it well. It is not easy to write with honesty and integrity, but history will never be forgotten, so long as those who write continue to do so.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Steals the first glyph encountered after a delay, losing Movement Speed

enemies.name: Thief in the Clouds - Erode
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Thief'. At the end of the history book is a comment in dried colored ink: 'The thief stole the ink, and sundered spring and autumn.' The writer's brush stops. How could one brush hope to stand against oblivion itself?

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Steals the first glyph encountered after a delay, losing Movement Speed

enemies.name: Frost Play
enemies.flavour_text: The work of 'White'. Invade and advance at the same time, relying not on advantage, nor placing oneself in disadvantage. 'Honor is vice; deceit is virtue.'

abilities.text: Becomes the glyph Broken when stamped, sealing its Glyph Tile

enemies.name: Frost Play - Fight
enemies.flavour_text: The work of 'White'. Like jade and gem complementing each other, like the stars illuminating the heavens. 'Honor is vice; deceit is virtue.'

abilities.text: Becomes the glyph Broken when stamped, sealing its Glyph Tile

enemies.name: Chun
enemies.flavour_text: 'The elf who wanders a thousand realms, the fire that illuminates the long night, the visitor lost in the past, the lingerer who reminisces on the departed.'

abilities.text: Immune to most control effects when using a skill

[Unsubmerged] After Stamp hits, stops moving and continuously absorbs <Matters of Money>, <Matters of Cooking>, <Wield Arms> and <Wield Arms - Oppress>, gaining barrier whenever one is successfully absorbed
[Opening Statement] Selects the nearest 'Soldier' Glyph Tile, then after a short delay stamps it once along with each connected Glyph Tile
Revives when HP drops to 0 for the first time, writes the Friend glyph on the two furthest Glyph Tiles, and immediately activates Stamp

enemies.name: 'Unquenched'
enemies.flavour_text: Sui's wrath. Go forth and face Its wrath head-on, if you are prepared to never return.

abilities.text: When ignited by [Wrath of Eons], deals Arts damage to your surrounding units

enemies.name: Ride Tide
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born from the brush of a great calligrapher, whose original name was 'Book'. 'Adversity births the chronicle; Darkness completes the tome.' The writings that expose stories of injustice will become the torch that guides those who are to come.

abilities.text: Writes the glyph Friend when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

enemies.name: Ride Tide - Return
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born from the brush of a great calligrapher, whose original name was 'Book'. 'Adversity births the chronicle; Darkness completes the tome.' The writings that expose stories of injustice will become the torch that lights the way home for the indomitable souls in the great river of history.

abilities.text: Writes the glyph Friend when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

enemies.name: Sui
enemies.flavour_text: The final god felled by Yan has risen again. It raises Its head and sees time immemorial from beginning to end, but It has never truly dwelled in the mortal realm.

abilities.text: The four body parts share an HP pool and cast skills in order; individual body parts leave the battlefield after taking a certain amount of damage
Parts are lifted when skills are used, preventing them from being attacked, and the tiles they are on become deployable and passable

Bringing a body part under the influence of a suppression pillar weakens the corresponding stats and skills; Sui gains a large stat bonus and takes less Physical and Arts damage when it is at full strength

[Wrath of Eons] Raises Sui's Head and breathes fire at the northmost ally after a delay, dealing Arts damage and inflicting Burn; flames spread southwards and continues to burn in an area, dealing Arts damage, inflicting Burn, and igniting <'Unquenched'>; remains on the field for a while
[Sundered Pillars] When HP falls below a certain point, summons extra enemies, and the 4 body parts simultaneously cast [Wrath of Eons], [Hidden Moon], [Shrouded Sun], and [Order Overturned]
Sui's ATK is reduced when weakened by a suppression pillar, and [Wrath of Eons] range is reduced
[Hidden Moon] and [Shrouded Sun] are cast together; lifts Left Claw of Sui and attacks the eastmost ally after a delay, dealing heavy Physical damage to all allies in the area
Sui's RES is reduced when weakened by a suppression pillar, and Its Left Claw will no longer use [Hidden Moon]
[Shrouded Sun] and [Hidden Moon] are cast together; lifts Right Claw of Sui and attacks the westmost ally after a delay, dealing heavy Physical damage to all allies in the area
Sui's DEF is reduced when weakened by a suppression pillar, and Its Right Claw will no longer use [Shrouded Sun]

[Order Overturned] Lifts Tail of Sui and attacks the southmost ally after a delay, dealing Physical damage to all allies in the area three times; spawns <'Unquenched'> based on the number of allies defeated this way
Sui's HP is reduced when weakened by a suppression pillar, and range and damage of [Order Overturned] are reduced

enemies.name: Matters of Money
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the beautiful wishes of the people, whose original name was 'Money'. In the Great Hunt a thousand years ago, the wealthy gave their wealth, and the poor their strength, joining forces to defeat the might of heaven. Historians recorded this for posterity and archived it in Sky Mirror Pavilion.

abilities.text: Friendly Unit
Grants DP when entering the Objective Point

enemies.name: Matters of Cooking
enemies.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the fire and smoke of kitchens, whose original name was 'Food'. In the Great Hunt a thousand years ago, the people worked their kitchens around the clock to supply the soldiers with food, giving them the courage to fight. Historians recorded this for posterity and archived it in Sky Mirror Pavilion.

abilities.text: Friendly Unit
Provides SP to friendly Operators when approaching them, then disappears

enemies.name: 'White'
enemies.flavour_text: A nightmare born of the void of 'evolution'. Long has it hidden in the shadows, but now it takes its place at the board.

abilities.text: Invulnerable
Summons <Frost Play> and <Frost Play - Fight> to affect the game
